  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace.{u_3} γ] {δ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace.{u_4} δ]
  {μa : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} α} {μb : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} β} {μc : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_3} γ}
  {μd : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_4} δ} [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_1} μa] [MeasureTheory.SFinite.{u_3} μc] {f : α → β}
  {g : γ → δ},

      MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.{max u_3 u_1, max u_4 u_2} (Prod.map.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} f g)
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_1, u_3} μa μc) (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod.{u_2, u_4} μb μd)
